statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds at least one PHP Group PHP CVE other than CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 with a date-added value between 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog JSON shows a PHP Group PHP entry, excluding CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, with dateAdded between 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No new PHP Group PHP entry with dateAdded in the window exists in the CISA KEV catalog at the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
